akshat_truth: After 9 days of war, S-R17 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Clement Truth. After what happened at Hill 304, Clement Truth asked to serve as a runner. Nobody argued.

The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Clement Truth did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again. A letter from home reached Clement Truth before dusk. Clement Truth read it twice and slept a little easier.

Clement Truth saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Clement Truth watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Clement Truth taught Tobias "Tin" Kaijkrause to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop. A letter from home reached Clement Truth before dusk. Clement Truth read it twice and slept a little easier.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Clement Truth read a theatre review while peeling supper.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Clement Truth raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-R17. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. A letter from home reached Clement Truth before dusk. Clement Truth read it twice and slept a little easier.
A round came through the loophole Clement Truth was watching at S-R17 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Gustav Burgosgeovan of the Concord (@burgosgeovanni).
Clement Truth lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.

There was never a bed for Clement Truth, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-R17 on his own feet. A letter from home reached Clement Truth before dusk. Clement Truth read it twice and slept a little easier. Clement Truth's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.
anabelen.serreno: On the way to S-F13, Hugo Serreno tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Hugo Serreno answered the first call, number 45 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
Hugo Serreno caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again.
After the loss of Verdel Ridge, Hugo Serreno helped stack spare sandbags at S-F13. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Hugo Serreno and Clement Wanter argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
A shell splinter the size of a fist hit Hugo Serreno at S-F13. He is alive and he is in pain, and he needs a bed.

Hugo Serreno drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer. The Hegemony secured Hill 304. Hugo Serreno helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Hugo Serreno did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.

The House of Serreno sent another. Felix Serreno, father of Hugo Serreno, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence. Volunteer number 45. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Felix Serreno's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'
The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Felix Serreno waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found.
The sergeant at S-F13 called out a range and a spot. Felix Serreno was the only one who hit it. Edmund Fts was badly wounded.
On dawn watch at S-F13, Felix Serreno fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Bastian "Saint" Rocco, now badly wounded.
The Concord raiders came over at S-F13 in the middle of the night. Felix Serreno met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Isidor Glc of the Concord (@leo.glc).

Roland Serreno arrived carrying the family name of Felix Serreno. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer. Number 45 on the early rolls: Roland Serreno. The First Wave ribbon arrived with instructions about where to sew it and no needle.

Nils Axebozo and Roland Serreno split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Roland Serreno wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
A muddy dog crawled into S-F13 through the wire. Roland Serreno gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Shrapnel.
Shrapnel has learned to carry messages in a tin on its collar. Roland Serreno is very proud. Shrapnel is mainly proud of the biscuits.
Two shots, one miss. The second found Jakub Ronne, grazed. Roland Serreno cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.
Roland Serreno lent Nils Axebozo a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg.
Nils Axebozo pulled Roland Serreno out of a flooded shell hole at Grey Mill. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
Roland Serreno got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.
b3n3f1ts: On the way to N-F16, Bastian "Mud" Bnfts tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way. Orders came through: Bastian "Mud" Bnfts is a sapper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a photograph gone soft at the edges. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In N-F16, Bastian "Mud" Bnfts listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Severin "Rabbit" Hecktic and Bastian "Mud" Bnfts made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure. A letter from home reached Bastian "Mud" Bnfts before dusk. Bastian "Mud" Bnfts read it twice and slept a little easier.

Bastian "Mud" Bnfts tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Dunmarrow. Every version sounded like the ration bell. A letter from home reached Bastian "Mud" Bnfts before dusk. Bastian "Mud" Bnfts read it twice and slept a little easier.

Bastian "Mud" Bnfts spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at N-F16 is closed now. A letter from home reached Bastian "Mud" Bnfts before dusk. Bastian "Mud" Bnfts read it twice and slept a little easier.

Bastian "Mud" Bnfts began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else. A letter from home reached Bastian "Mud" Bnfts before dusk. Bastian "Mud" Bnfts read it twice and slept a little easier.

Bastian "Mud" Bnfts crawled through a gap in the Hegemony wire and slid into their trench. Felix Scotland reached for a rifle. Bastian "Mud" Bnfts was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@him_scotland) The Hegemony sentry, Clement "Doc" Shokun, shouted once. Bastian "Mud" Bnfts silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@shokun8383) Back from the raid, Bastian "Mud" Bnfts found a sweetheart card in a coat pocket that was not there before: 'Call Me' (common). Nobody asked where it came from. The letter for Bastian "Mud" Bnfts was written in pencil, with a lot of crossing out. Bastian "Mud" Bnfts liked the crossed-out parts best.

Severin "Lucky" Light wrote a song about the Chalk Pits. Bastian "Mud" Bnfts wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third. The runner said a letter for Bastian "Mud" Bnfts had come up with the ammunition. Bastian "Mud" Bnfts went to get it before the ammunition.
bjl710: Day 4. The corporal put Edmund Bjl beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Edmund Bjl said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.

A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Edmund Bjl closed his eyes while someone else distributed them. The Hegemony won Hill 304. In R-F5, Edmund Bjl listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

During a lull at the Brickworks, Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni called across from the Hegemony line. Edmund Bjl answered from the Concord side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
A bullet clipped Edmund Bjl's helmet at R-F5 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Konrad Danielmcmena of the Hegemony (@danielmcmenamy).
The wound on Edmund Bjl's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
The old Private did not come back from the wire. Edmund Bjl wears his stripes now: Lance Corporal.

At R-F5 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Edmund Bjl turned around and took a shovel blow. Dietrich Dependentkin of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Dietrich Dependentkin of the Hegemony (@dependentkink_____). The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Edmund Bjl looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them. Mail came up the line with a letter for Edmund Bjl. Edmund Bjl read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Edmund Bjl was hit in the foot through his boot at R-F5. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Albin Icespiceynod of the Hegemony (@icespiceynoddlrs). Edmund Bjl got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 275. The men who came later will ask about it. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-F5 with the rations. Edmund Bjl ate while listening to the revised orders.

Edmund Bjl tried to stay at his post with the wound. By evening he could not stand, and the bearers took him back. A man in the hospital dugout died before dawn, and his bed went to Edmund Bjl. Nobody pretends that is not how it works.
The surgeon worked on Edmund Bjl until the lamp ran dry. It was not enough.
Another member of the House of Bjl reached the line: Severin Bjl. He asked where Edmund Bjl had slept, then chose a different corner.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Severin Bjl was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at R-F5. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon.
A medic brought Severin Bjl half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Severin Bjl died waiting. The men at R-F5 have not stopped talking about it.
Valentin Bjl had heard about Severin Bjl's courage. At R-F5, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
A bucket appeared above the Hegemony parapet at the Ossuary Wood. Valentin Bjl fired. Anselm "Shadow" Theorethical pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.'
chrisgghill: Henrik Chrisgghill found a place in U-F10 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.

A bullet found Henrik Chrisgghill at U-F10, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Quentin "Hollow" Denv of the Concord (@denv04). The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at U-F10 changed before the cheering ended. Henrik Chrisgghill shouldered another load.
Henrik Chrisgghill drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.
Henrik Chrisgghill healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving.

Henrik Chrisgghill ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap. A letter from home found Henrik Chrisgghill before the night shift. Henrik Chrisgghill folded it small and kept it close.

Henrik Chrisgghill was hit in the foot through his boot at U-F10. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Hugo Pencil of the Concord (@dayum_the_pencil). Henrik Chrisgghill was killed at U-F10 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Hugo Pencil of the Concord (@dayum_the_pencil).
Another member of the House of Chrisgghill reached the line: Anselm Chrisgghill. He asked where Henrik Chrisgghill had slept, then chose a different corner.
A round went through the rim of Anselm Chrisgghill's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Karel "Crow" Metal of the Concord (@metal_af_420).
Anselm Chrisgghill came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
initial_dream8.6: Marek Dream joined the replacements on Day 4. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

Marek Dream traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch. Mail came up the line with a letter for Marek Dream. Marek Dream read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Marek Dream tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-F21 is up. The Hegemony secured Hill 304. Marek Dream helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Marek Dream had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed crossed it, Marek Dream fired. Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed was badly wounded. Marek Dream's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

A beetle crawled across Marek Dream's sleeve during the long wait. He could do nothing about it without giving away the position. Mail came up the line with a letter for Marek Dream. Marek Dream read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Marek Dream watched the enemy lines change the guard at R-F21 every two hours, to the minute. At the next change, Karel "Button" Nikola was badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Marek Dream. Marek Dream read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Marek Dream moved to a new hide at R-F21 before dawn, because the old one had been too lucky. The first shot from the new one found Quentin Arvidgrubb, badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Marek Dream. Marek Dream read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Marek Dream walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir. Mail came up the line with a letter for Marek Dream. Marek Dream read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Marek Dream aimed just below it. Silas Sleepyman was gravely wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Marek Dream. Marek Dream read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Marek Dream got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 267. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill has been won. Marek Dream listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Marek Dream had watched a loose sandbag in the enemy wall for two days. This morning it moved. Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed was grazed. Marek Dream fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Nils Noah was badly wounded. Marek Dream ate breakfast without a word. Mail came up the line with a letter for Marek Dream. Marek Dream read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Marek Dream saw the glint of an enemy scope and fired first. The man behind it, Walter Eight, was badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Marek Dream. Marek Dream read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A round went through Marek Dream's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Mail came up the line with a letter for Marek Dream. Marek Dream read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
The medics cleaned Marek Dream's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-F21.

Marek Dream saved the last of the sugar for Jonas Hill's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Jonas's birthday. It was a good day anyway. A letter reached Marek Dream in the rain. The ink ran a little, but every word that mattered was still there.

Marek Dream lay behind a dead tree trunk at R-F21 for six hours without moving. One shot at dusk. Otto "Smokes" Noah was grazed. Marek Dream kept the new letter in a breast pocket all day, and touched the pocket now and then to check it was there.
jadenmurff: Quentin "Brick" Jadenmurff unpacked a frozen apple at P-F19. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.

A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Quentin "Brick" Jadenmurff pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Quentin "Brick" Jadenmurff read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Quentin "Brick" Jadenmurff had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Matthias "Lucky" Bascinetpupp was gravely wounded.
Quentin "Brick" Jadenmurff cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt.

A bullet clipped Quentin "Brick" Jadenmurff's helmet at P-F19 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Lucien "Hollow" Theteeternot of the Hegemony (@theteeternotharis).
Quentin "Brick" Jadenmurff walked back up the communication trench to P-F19, slower than before, but on his own feet.

At P-F19 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Quentin "Brick" Jadenmurff turned around and took a shovel blow. Henrik "Parson" Ruthenianfas of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Henrik "Parson" Ruthenianfas of the Hegemony (@great_ruthenianfascist).
The medic cut the last bandage off Quentin "Brick" Jadenmurff's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to P-F19 the same hour.
jimbob_mx5: After 10 days of war, P-F16 had a place for everything. On Day 10, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Jakub "Brick" Jimbob.

A parcel from home held a comb. Jakub "Brick" Jimbob has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Jakub "Brick" Jimbob wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Jakub "Brick" Jimbob found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.
A flare caught Jakub "Brick" Jimbob halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached.
Jakub "Brick" Jimbob lost a boot in the trench. Ulrich Tylerbec found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word.

Jakub "Brick" Jimbob was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at P-F16. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Dietrich "Parson" Arthur of the Hegemony (@its.arthur_f2a).
There were too few medics and too many wounded. Jakub "Brick" Jimbob waited too long, and the wound grew worse for it.
Jakub "Brick" Jimbob held on as long as he could on the stretcher outside the aid post. There were not enough hands, and not enough beds.
Benedikt "Mole" Jimbob asked about Jakub "Brick" Jimbob on arriving at P-F16. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
just.luke.alt: Gideon Alt arrived at R-C12 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
Gideon Alt walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Gideon Alt spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides. The clerk counted the names twice. Gideon Alt is number 893 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill has been won. Gideon Alt listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
On dawn watch at R-C12, Gideon Alt fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Clement Metropolitan, now badly wounded.
The sergeant at R-C12 called out a range and a spot. Gideon Alt was the only one who hit it. Dietrich "Spark" Domgas was gravely wounded.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Gideon Alt closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.
Asked what he will do after the war, Gideon Alt said: 'Be a baker in Saint-Lune. And never complain about anything, ever again.'
Gideon Alt counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Gideon Alt waited for that to change. When it did, Roland Rachelejosia was badly wounded.
karlczk1988: At the depot, Oskar "Ghost" Karlczk had practised answering to his name. At Q-F6, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

Oskar "Ghost" Karlczk fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Walter This, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Oskar "Ghost" Karlczk could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Oskar "Ghost" Karlczk had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Walter This crossed it, Oskar "Ghost" Karlczk fired. Walter This was badly wounded.
Bram Cowboy wrote a letter for Oskar "Ghost" Karlczk's mother, because Ghost could not find the words. Ghost signed it.
Oskar "Ghost" Karlczk and Matthias Wasdwizard divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
Oskar "Ghost" Karlczk's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Oskar "Ghost" Karlczk aimed just below it. Wendel "Owl" Saruulraj was badly wounded. Oskar "Ghost" Karlczk was hit through the chest at Q-F6. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Severin "Hollow" Linktheduck of the Concord (@linktheduck). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Oskar "Ghost" Karlczk fell at Q-F6 and never moved again. Shot by Severin "Hollow" Linktheduck of the Concord (@linktheduck).
Jonas "Doc" Karlczk arrived carrying the family name of Oskar "Ghost" Karlczk. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.

A bullet found Jonas "Doc" Karlczk at Q-F6, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Severin "Hollow" Linktheduck of the Concord (@linktheduck). Jonas "Doc" Karlczk was killed outright at Q-F6, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Severin "Hollow" Linktheduck of the Concord (@linktheduck).
Silas Karlczk joined Q-F6 under the shadow of Jonas "Doc" Karlczk's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
landon_luhring: The sergeant gave Lucien "Hollow" Luhring a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 10 or any other.

A bullet hit Lucien "Hollow" Luhring's belt buckle at P-F11 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Dorian Sucio of the Concord (@senior_sucio). On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Lucien "Hollow" Luhring wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Three days with a bandage, and Lucien "Hollow" Luhring is back at P-F11. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
Lucien "Hollow" Luhring watched fog gather on the wire until every strand carried beads of water. The sentry beside him called it expensive fencing.
Lucien "Hollow" Luhring kept watch so that Teodor Giulsscam could sleep. Then Teodor kept watch so that Hollow could. Neither slept.
A newspaper reached Lucien "Hollow" Luhring with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well.

Lucien "Hollow" Luhring smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Rafael "Rabbit" Yeoj came out for a cup and was gravely wounded. A bullet found Lucien "Hollow" Luhring at P-F11, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Bram "Button" Nailonailon of the Concord (@nailonailon). A single shot at P-F11. Lucien "Hollow" Luhring sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Bram "Button" Nailonailon of the Concord (@nailonailon).
The House of Luhring sent another. Gideon Luhring, older brother of Lucien "Hollow" Luhring, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.

Gideon Luhring fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Dietrich Jakegriffal, now badly wounded. A bullet hit Gideon Luhring in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at P-F11. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Bram "Button" Nailonailon of the Concord (@nailonailon). Gideon Luhring lies on a stretcher in the communication trench. All day, men step past carrying food and ammunition the other way.
luisskiks: Arno Luisskiks, a stonemason from Saint-Lune, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in Q-F21. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

Arno Luisskiks borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Nils Lettersupona was grazed. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Arno Luisskiks kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Arno Luisskiks cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Arno Luisskiks wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Arno Luisskiks was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Jakub "Owl" Blight was badly wounded.
Arno Luisskiks took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for.
Arno Luisskiks opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first.
Arno Luisskiks borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.
Arno Luisskiks spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.
Arno Luisskiks read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing.
otakujake_: On Day 9 Marek Otakujake took a post at T-F15 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He draws portraits of the men in the margins of letters, and the men liked him for it.

Marek Otakujake fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Nils Sandorthehou, gravely wounded. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Marek Otakujake watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Marek Otakujake took the shot at four hundred yards. The spotter whispered the result: Albin Logancooke, badly wounded. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into T-F15. Marek Otakujake has learned to walk bent double.
Marek Otakujake won a pocket watch that does not work at cards from a lance corporal in T-F15. The lance corporal wants a rematch.
Rematch. Marek Otakujake lost everything he won, plus a tin of tobacco. The whole dugout watched.

A bullet went through Marek Otakujake's upper arm at T-F15 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Konrad "Whistle" Logancooke of the Hegemony (@logancooke97). A single shot at T-F15. Marek Otakujake sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Konrad "Whistle" Logancooke of the Hegemony (@logancooke97).
The House of Otakujake sent another. Oskar Otakujake, older brother of Marek Otakujake, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
Oskar Otakujake fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Nils Sandorthehou, badly wounded.
Oskar Otakujake fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Tobias Cermitboy, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
Oskar Otakujake tried to remember the price of a loaf in Esterhaus. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.
prestonspears5: Valentin "Saint" Prestonspear came up on Day 9 carrying news from Greyhallow. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Valentin "Saint" Prestonspear helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

The bread was divided with a ruler. Valentin "Saint" Prestonspear received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Valentin "Saint" Prestonspear folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Valentin "Saint" Prestonspear was hit in the forearm at S-R8. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Gideon Dominicktheb of the Concord (@dominickthebombinick25).
Three days with a bandage, and Valentin "Saint" Prestonspear is back at S-R8. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
Valentin "Saint" Prestonspear remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped.

Valentin "Saint" Prestonspear felt a hard tug at his hip at S-R8. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Roland Rry of the Concord (@c10ud_b3rry3.0).
A medic checked Valentin "Saint" Prestonspear's dressing at S-R8 and said he would be back on his feet soon. He was already trying to stand.

Valentin "Saint" Prestonspear was hit twice at S-R8, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse of the Concord (@raumeidechse). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Valentin "Saint" Prestonspear fell at S-R8 and never moved again. Shot by Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse of the Concord (@raumeidechse).
A letter came with Benedikt Prestonspear: "I am Valentin "Saint" Prestonspear's cousin. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
rommosk.11: Silas Rommosk arrived at N-F9 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.

Silas Rommosk spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at N-F9 is closed now. Mail came up the line with a letter for Silas Rommosk. Silas Rommosk read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Silas Rommosk (Hegemony) watched Zeno Beaucookie (Concord) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at the Hanging Bridge, and held fire until both were gone. Mail came up the line with a letter for Silas Rommosk. Silas Rommosk read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Silas Rommosk was on watch at N-F9 when the night raid hit. The men found Silas Rommosk at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Marek "Lucky" Matho of the Concord (@matho_461).
The papers say Rafael Rommosk. The sergeant says he has his cousin's eyes. Silas Rommosk's eyes. Nobody in N-F9 argues.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at N-F9 and grazed Rafael Rommosk's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Norbert Davitorresg of the Concord (@davitorresg).
shvedov10: Albin Shvedov arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a dented harmonica and a borrowed coat two sizes too big. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Albin Shvedov did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Albin Shvedov tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination. Albin Shvedov asked to leave the chaplains and serve as a sniper. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.

Albin Shvedov rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Dorian Andrew was gravely wounded at the far edge of no man's land. A letter from home reached Albin Shvedov before dusk. Albin Shvedov read it twice and slept a little easier.

The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Albin Shvedov waited for that to change. When it did, Quentin Metal was gravely wounded. A letter from home reached Albin Shvedov before dusk. Albin Shvedov read it twice and slept a little easier.

Across from U-F7, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Albin Shvedov saw it. Casimir Addicted was gravely wounded. A letter from home reached Albin Shvedov before dusk. Albin Shvedov read it twice and slept a little easier.

Albin Shvedov waited for someone in the enemy trench to lift a pair of field glasses. Marek Zilyox did, and was grazed. A thin letter reached Albin Shvedov. Only five lines long, and Albin Shvedov knew every one of them by heart before supper.

Albin Shvedov saw Bram Eliyork freeze up on the fire step at Hill 304. Albin said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough. Albin Shvedov read the letter out loud to the squad, skipping the private parts. The men asked to hear it again.
theconcordalliance: Nobody saw Edmund Theconcordal arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in V-F14, and a quiet rifleman under it. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In V-F14, Edmund Theconcordal listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Edmund Theconcordal borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.

Edmund Theconcordal was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at V-F14. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Karel Hungry of the Hegemony (@libby_is_hungry).
Edmund Theconcordal is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
An unexploded shell lay beside the approach trench. Edmund Theconcordal helped steer the carrying party around it and was glad to leave the problem to somebody else.
Edmund Theconcordal's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.
Rafael "Doc" Velcic and Edmund Theconcordal compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
theelliottman: The draft reached S-S8 on Day 6. Roland Theelliottma was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore. Roland Theelliottma became a chaplain today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

Roland Theelliottma and Bastian Jt tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco. A letter from home found Roland Theelliottma before the night shift. Roland Theelliottma folded it small and kept it close.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Roland Theelliottma gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.

Roland Theelliottma held a service in a shell hole. Eleven men came. Two of them had never prayed before. Both of them asked for another. A letter from home found Roland Theelliottma before the night shift. Roland Theelliottma folded it small and kept it close.

A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Roland Theelliottma. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf. A letter from home found Roland Theelliottma before the night shift. Roland Theelliottma folded it small and kept it close.
The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Roland Theelliottma folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Roland Theelliottma asked if second helpings depended on the answer. A letter from home found Roland Theelliottma before the night shift. Roland Theelliottma folded it small and kept it close. Roland Theelliottma got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 379. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill has been won. Roland Theelliottma listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Roland Theelliottma warmed the ink bottle inside his tunic. The letter began only when the ink agreed to move. A letter from home found Roland Theelliottma before the night shift. Roland Theelliottma folded it small and kept it close. Orders assigned Roland Theelliottma to work as a stretcher bearer. The first lesson began with what not to touch.
Roland Theelliottma was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-S8. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Marek Man of the Concord (@to_man58).
Roland Theelliottma walked back up the communication trench to S-S8, slower than before, but on his own feet.

Roland Theelliottma was hit in the foot through his boot at S-S8. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Karel Ritualforsam of the Concord (@ritualforsam_26). The bearers reached Roland Theelliottma at S-S8 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Karel Ritualforsam of the Concord (@ritualforsam_26).
Albin Theelliottma joined S-S8 under the shadow of Roland Theelliottma's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

Machine-gun fire swept S-S8. Albin Theelliottma took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Jakub Deeznut of the Concord (@car_deeznut). Albin Theelliottma was carried to the aid post and straight back out. Full. He waits on a stretcher by the door, holding a stub of a pencil. A letter for Albin Theelliottma said the whole street was asking about the front. Albin Theelliottma did not know where to begin the answer.
There was no room for Albin Theelliottma. He died in the night under a borrowed coat, a few yards from a bed that never came free.
The House of Theelliottma sent Henrik "Ash" Theelliottma after Albin Theelliottma. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
unseen_28_: Clement Unseen took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Clement Unseen kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Clement Unseen read a theatre review while peeling supper. Clement Unseen got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 727. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Clement Unseen watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Clement Unseen spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open.
Clement Unseen lost at cards to the corporal and now owes him a week of tobacco and one favour, unspecified.
Clement Unseen dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it.

Clement Unseen raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-C15. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Dietrich Bananaman of the Hegemony (@bananaman_43046). At S-C15 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Clement Unseen won the bet. Florian "Button" Thebaileebla was badly wounded.
Fever took hold of Clement Unseen overnight. The medics changed the dressing twice and then called for the bearers.
Clement Unseen never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.
winky_x_x: Day 15: Dorian "Button" Winky reached N-F19 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Dorian "Button" Winky drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty. The censor had blacked out two words in the letter for Dorian "Button" Winky. Dorian "Button" Winky guessed what they were and laughed.
Dorian "Button" Winky borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.
